verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no product-native way to set up user-defined automations that run on a schedule or trigger in the background. The API and the MCP server are developer building blocks or interactive chat-driven actions. Watchlist monitoring and backorder requests are adjacent, single-purpose features, not configurable recurring automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
